title: Crunchy Walnut Salad
description: A refreshing and crunchy salad perfect for a light lunch. The combination of crispy walnuts, fresh greens, and tangy dressing will delight your taste buds.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chopped lettuce, diced apple, and thinly sliced red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together balsamic vinaigrette, salt, and pepper.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Sprinkle crumbled feta cheese over the top of the salad.
Sprinkle chopped walnuts over the salad and serve immediately.
